title: 200 Watchers swear an oath on Mount Hermon
summary: Tim Alberino tells of 200 Watchers swear an oath on Mount Hermon, about antediluvian, days of Jared at Mount Hermon, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they did this thing, they bound themselves on the summit of Mount Hermon. According to the Book of Enoch, they descended on the summit of Mount Hermon

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher and filmmaker, retells a story from the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text, and from Genesis 6, a chapter of the Bible. He says that in the days before the Great Flood, 200 heavenly beings called the Watchers came down on the summit of Mount Hermon, a mountain in the Middle East, and bound themselves together by an oath there. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as the origin of the giants that, by his account, came after.
